user_query: Use the optical Cartosat-2S and RISAT-1A SAR images together to identify flooded agricultural land beneath cloud cover in the Kaziranga Brahmaputra basin.
user_query_hi: कार्टोसैट-2एस और रीसैट-1ए रडार छवियों का उपयोग करके काजीरंगा में बाढ़ग्रस्त कृषि भूमि की पहचान करें।
grounded_response: Cross-modal analysis reveals 1,420 hectares of inundated cropland. While 45% of optical imagery was obscured by monsoon cumulus clouds, C-band SAR backscatter (-18.4 dB) successfully penetrated cloud cover to delineate waterlogged perimeters with 96.8% confidence.

user_query: What changed in built-up infrastructure around Bengaluru Peripheral Ring Road between March 2023 and January 2026?
user_query_hi: मार्च 2023 और जनवरी 2026 के बीच बेंगलुरु पेरिफेरल रिंग रोड के बुनियादी ढांचे में क्या बदलाव आया?
grounded_response: Built-up area expanded by +28.4% (+340 hectares). Commercial logistics hubs and highway overpass construction converted previous barren/scrubland plots. Vegetation cover decreased by -14.2%.
